UI FANOUT PASS 2 — MOBILE CONTROLS / ERGONOMICS. Audit the Onslaught source reconstruction specifically as a mobile shooter UX engineer. Improve the visible touch-control UI and responsive layout without changing the established event-driven input architecture or breaking desktop. Focus on thumb reach, spacing, hit targets, safe areas, landscape phones, avoiding overlap with HUD/start/game-over UI, visual distinction between move/look/fire/ADS/reload/slide/weapon controls, opacity/readability during combat, and preventing the controls from obscuring enemies. Keep the interface fitting for a dark zombie shooter and avoid generic bright app styling. Preserve the requirement that touch controls are hidden/non-interactive when gameplay is not running. Prefer conservative CSS/DOM changes around the existing mobile-source-bridge and style system. Return a coherent unified diff within the allowlisted source-reconstruction scope, plus exact tests the lead should run. Do not claim tests were run.
